messages.subject: external links and headers
parts:
Hi, I'm trying to figure out how to build a Shiny app that accesses the Meetup API with OAuth2. (Borrowing lots of code from people who have done the same for Google OAuth2.)

App: https://harlanh.shinyapps.io/shiny-meetup-test
Source: https://github.com/HarlanH/shiny-meetup-test/

I've got it working locally, but am having two issues when deploying to Shinyapps.io.

First, the link for authentication fails. I get the following in the Javascript console. 

Refused to display 'https://secure.meetup.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=b8s71jq5aon4bk5nbtv46d…onse_type=code&redirect_uri=https://harlanh.shinyapps.io/shiny-meetup-test' in a frame because it set 'X-Frame-Options' to 'sameorigin'.

How do I work around that? If I Control-Click to open in a new window, it does work.

Second, if I'm logged in, then reload, then click the authenticate button again, I get a doubled RStudio header:



How do I work around this?

Thanks! I'm kinda amazed this works at all! 

 -Harlan

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] external links and headers
parts:
Harlin,

The X-Frame-Options is coming from meetup.com. Basically they are not allowing the OAuth2 authorization page to be displayed in a frame (for whatever reason). 

To work around this, you should change your login link (a tag) to use have target="_top". This will open the link OUTSIDE your applications iframe. When the user logins, they will then be redirected back to the app.
